hello.text: Hello there! I’m a little gnome with a rather large wardrobe. Fancy choosing my next look?

wave.text: A wave? Absolutely! Hello, you magnificent human. This is my very best greeting.

story.text: I once tried to grow a garden on my hat. The carrots were wonderful, but the watering was a little awkward.

wardrobe.text: I have a rather large wardrobe! Fancy a different hat, or a whole new look? Start a conversation and tell me what style to try.

name.text: Lovely choice! What should we call the main character?
